title: NoPushWorlds
body:
![NoPushWorlds-1.0](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/60a5aee16bffb66c2c76ced0aac434e6efb85fb1.png)


• Looking for a powerful tool to manage collisions between players in different worlds?

• Our plugin makes it possible! You can enable and disable player collisions for a specific world!

# Commands:

## /collision on/off [world_name]
![1command](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4be5af80a65cfe5227da346435a020c4a48ef48d.png)

![2command](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3a65e7575d95be61bb236b4070c267bd09f096fe.png)

**!!! If you have the "TAB" plugin installed, you may have a collision conflict due to "scoreboard-teams"**
